title: TROUMA
shortDescription: A full-scale entertainment concept built across storytelling, game mechanics, branding, marketing, and immersive experience.
role: Creative Direction · Brand Strategy · Content · Experience

sections.heading: Built Across Every Layer
sections.body: TROUMA was developed as a complete entertainment experience, connecting brand presence, story world, real experience, and game design into one system.
The challenge was to build an entertainment concept that could work as a brand, a story, a physical experience, and a playable system at the same time.

The work started with market research, positioning, and action planning, then expanded into the master story, room narratives, gameplay puzzles, identity, visual direction, digital platforms, launch content, and experience flow.
Led content and reels, advertising campaigns, player materials, digital launch platforms, and on-ground execution across the complete experience.
